# Mowglai Digital Agency

## Transparent Pricing Structure
Mowglai offers deterministic, upfront pricing without hidden charges:
- **Basic Website Package**: Starts at ₹5,000 INR / $55 USD
  - Single-page custom design, mobile responsiveness, basic SEO, contact form, 1 month support.
- **Advanced Architecture Package**: Starts at ₹9,999 INR / $110 USD
  - Up to 5 custom pages, GSAP/Framer animations, CMS integration, advanced analytics, 3 months support.
- **Store Essential E-Commerce**: Starts at ₹12,999 INR / $149 USD
  - Online storefront, product catalog, cart, checkout, Stripe/Razorpay/UPI integration, order invoicing.
- **Commerce Pro / Multi-Vendor Marketplace**: Starts at ₹24,999 INR / $299 USD
  - Complex product matrix, live inventory sync, courier API logistics hub, seller & admin dashboard.
- **Apex Enterprise & 3D Web System**: Starts at ₹49,999+ INR / $599+ USD
  - Bespoke 3D WebGL architecture, neural AI workflow integration, dedicated engineering team.
- **Mowglai Care & Growth Maintenance**:
  - Mowglai Care: ₹1,299/month ($15/month)
  - Mowglai Growth: ₹3,499/month ($39/month)
